scene.title: scene
scene.description:
A loom scene file (`docs/architecture.md` section 10). The file is RON;
this schema describes the same data as JSON: a RON tuple such as
`(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)` is a fixed-length array; an optional field may be left
out, and when given is written bare in RON (`mesh: Cube`, not
`mesh: Some(Cube)`); an enum such as `mesh` is serde's externally tagged
form: a unit variant is its name (`"Cube"`), a variant with fields an
object with one key (`{"Capsule": {"radius": 0.35, "height": 1.8}}`).
Loading checks more than the structure: the rules are in the field
descriptions.

ambient.description: Ambient light, linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1.

camera.description:
Path of the active camera node: names joined by "/" from a root
node. The node needs a camera component.

game.description:
Which game runs the scene, e.g. "souls" or "rogue"; `loom run` picks
the game by it. Not empty.

nodes.description: The root nodes, in drawing and checking order.

clips.description:
`(name, path)` pairs: each clip's name and the path of its RON clip
file (the `clip` schema), relative to the working directory. At
least one; names and paths not empty, each name given once. A list,
not a map: ron silently keeps the last of two duplicate map keys.

play.description: The clip played from tick 0: one of `clips`' names.

CameraDesc.description: A camera: `near` and `far` in meters, `0 < near < far`.

far.description: Meters to the far clipping plane.

fov_y.description:
Perspective: vertical field of view in degrees, between 0 and 180.
Exactly one of `fov_y` and `ortho` is given.

near.description: Meters to the near clipping plane.

CapsuleDesc.description: An upright capsule standing on the node's origin.

height.description: Meters from the bottom to the top, greater than 0.

CharacterDesc.description: Makes the node the character the game moves.

capsule.description:
The upright capsule the character collides and is hit with, when
the node draws something else (a model). The game says when it is
needed.

ColliderKind.description: Static collision shapes, sized and placed by the node's transform.

oneOf.description: Unit cube like `mesh: Cube`.

LightDesc.description: A directional light, shining along the node's -Z axis.

color.description: Linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1.

MeshKind.description: Mesh shapes. The first three are unit sized; size them with `scale`.

oneOf.description: Edge 1, centered at the origin.
1x1 on the XZ plane, facing +Y.
Diameter 1, centered at the origin.

A cylinder along Y capped by two half spheres. `height` includes the
caps; the origin is at the bottom, so it spans y in `[0, height]`.
Requires `radius > 0` and `height >= 2 * radius`.

NodeDesc.description: A scene node. Every number must be finite.

animation.description: The model's animation clips, played from tick 0. Only with `model`.

bone.description:
A bone of the parent node's model: the node and its subtree move
with it on screen, offset along the model's axes. Not empty; the
parent needs a `model`.

camera.description: Makes the node a camera, looking along its -Z axis.

character.description: The scene's one character, if any.

children.description: Child nodes, placed relative to this one.

collider.description:
A static collision shape. Not on the character's node; the node may
only rotate around Y (rotation x and z 0, no look_at), and its
ancestors only translate.

color.description:
The mesh color, linear RGB, each component from 0 to 1. Default
(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), or (1, 1, 1) with a `model`: a model's color
tints its vertex colors.

display_name.description:
A name for people to read, e.g. over a boss's health bar. Not
empty; which characters it may have is the game's to say.

light.description: The scene's one light, if any.

look_at.description:
A point, in the parent's space, that the node's -Z axis turns to.
Not the node's own position, and not straight above or below it.

model.description:
Path of a glTF binary model (`.glb`), relative to the working
directory. Not empty. At most one of `mesh`, `model`, `sprite` and
`tilemap`.

orbit_camera.description: The scene's one orbit camera, if any: on a node with a camera.

position.description: Local position in meters, relative to the parent. Default (0, 0, 0).

props.description:
Numbers for the game to interpret, as `(name, value)` pairs in file
order: names match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, each given once, values
finite. Which names a game knows, and their rules, are under
`games.<game>.props`. A list, not a map: ron silently keeps the last
of two duplicate map keys.

rotation.description: YXZ Euler angles in degrees. Not together with `look_at`.

OrbitCameraDesc.description: A camera that orbits the character, as in Dark Souls.

collision_radius.description:
Radius of the camera's collision sphere, in meters:
`0 < collision_radius < pivot_height`.

distance.description: Meters from the pivot, greater than 0.

pitch.description:
Starting angle in degrees, between `pitch_min` and `pitch_max`;
positive looks up.

pivot_height.description: Meters above the character's feet the camera orbits around.

return_speed.description:
Meters per second the camera moves back out once unblocked, greater
than 0.

target.description: Path (from a root) of the node with the `character` component.

height.description:
World length the view covers vertically, greater than 0; the width
follows the aspect ratio.

SpriteDesc.description: A sprite: one tag of an Aseprite sheet, drawn on the node's XY plane.

alternates.description:
Other tags of the sheet the game may switch the sprite to while it
runs: each once, and not `tag`.

sheet.description:
Path of an Aseprite json-array sprite sheet, relative to the
working directory. Not empty.

tag.description: The tag shown, one of the sheet's. Not empty.

TilemapDesc.description:
A tile map: rows of characters, each drawing a tag of an Aseprite
sheet, one cell a unit square on the node's XY plane.

legend.description: Which tag each map character draws; each character once.

rows.description:
One string per row, top row first; one character per cell, every
character in the legend. At least one row, all of the same length,
at least 1.

sheet.description:
Path of an Aseprite json-array sprite sheet, relative to the
working directory. Not empty.

clip.title: clip
clip.description:
A loom animation clip file (`docs/architecture.md` section 19). The
file is RON; this schema describes the same data as JSON: a keyframe
`(30, (25.0, 0.0, 0.0))` is a two-item array of the tick and a
three-item array; an optional field may be left out, and when given is
written bare in RON (`rotation: [...]`, not `rotation: Some([...])`).
Loading checks more than the structure: the rules are in the field
descriptions.

bones.description:
Bone name (a joint of the model's skin) to its channels; may be
empty (the bind pose). Bones not listed keep their bind pose.

length.description: The clip's length in ticks (1/60 s), greater than 0.

looping.description:
`true`: the clip repeats, tick `length` being tick 0 again; `false`:
it stops at its last tick.

BoneDesc.description:
One bone's channels: at least one of the two. Values are offsets from
the bind pose along the model's axes (+X right, +Y up, -Z forward), not
the bone's own axes; a parent's motion carries its children's axes.

translation.description:
`(tick, (x, y, z))` keyframes of a move in meters. At least one;
ticks strictly increasing, each at most `length`; values finite.

props.description: The player's health.

props.name: hp

props.name: attack
props.description: Health the zombie's hit takes off.

props.name: speed
props.description: Energy gained each turn; it acts on reaching 100, so 100 is the player's speed and 67 acts on 2 turns out of 3.

state_dump.title: StateDump
state_dump.description:
Generic over the game state only so that `loom schema` can describe
each game's dump from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

actions.description: Actions active in the last tick, sorted by name.

axes.description: Every mapped axis with its value in the last tick, sorted by name.

nodes.description:
Every scene node's local transform, and its animation if it has
one, keyed by path (sorted).

tick.description: Ticks run since the scene was loaded.

AnimationState.description:
What an animated model plays (`docs/architecture.md` section 19,
"播放速度和片段起点").

blend.description: Ticks the blend from `from` takes; 0 switches at once.

blend_start.description: The tick the blend from `from` starts at.

from.description: The clip blended from, `null` until the first switch.

offset.description: The clip time at `start`, in hundredths of a tick.

rate.description: Playing speed in percent: 100 is as written, 0 holds still.

start.description: The tick this stretch of it is counted from.

ClipStart.description:
A clip and how its time runs: `offset` hundredths of a tick at tick
`start`, then `rate` a tick.

GameState.description: The game state in the state dump (`game`).

messages.description: Every message so far, oldest first.

turn.description: Turns taken so far: moves, attacks and waits.

zombies.description: In scene pre-order; dead ones stay, with `hp` 0, on their corpse.

Message.description: A line of the message log.

turn.description: The turn the message belongs to (after that turn was counted).

NodeState.description:
One node in a state dump: its local transform (relative to the parent)
and, for an animated model, what plays (`docs/architecture.md` section
19): the clip names and ticks, not the bones' pose.

animation.description: Only on a node with an `animation`.

rotation.description: A unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`.

cell.description: `[column, row]`; row 0 is the map's top row.

energy.description: Gained `speed` per turn, spent 100 per action.

trace_line.title: TraceLine
trace_line.description:
One line of a trace, the fields in this order. Generic only so that `loom schema` can describe a
game's lines from this same type (`docs/architecture.md` section 17).

events.description: The events that tick emitted, in order.

state.description: The state dump after the tick.

tick.description: The tick the line is about: its state is after that tick ran.

AnimationState.description:
What an animated model plays (`docs/architecture.md` section 19,
"播放速度和片段起点").

blend.description: Ticks the blend from `from` takes; 0 switches at once.

blend_start.description: The tick the blend from `from` starts at.

from.description: The clip blended from, `null` until the first switch.

offset.description: The clip time at `start`, in hundredths of a tick.

rate.description: Playing speed in percent: 100 is as written, 0 holds still.

ClipStart.description:
A clip and how its time runs: `offset` hundredths of a tick at tick
`start`, then `rate` a tick.

Event.description:
One event of a tick, for traces and `loom serve`'s `step`
(`docs/architecture.md` section 15, "事件"); serialized as an object
whose first field is `type`.

oneOf.description:
The player bumped into a zombie, or a zombie bit the player: one
per `You hit`, `You kill` or `bites you` message.

hp.description: The target's hp after the hit.

target.description: The node path of the one hit.

Message.description: A line of the message log.

constraints: each move per tick is shorter than the capsule radius: sprint_speed / 60, roll_distance / roll_ticks, backstep_distance / backstep_ticks, attack_distance / attack_active_ticks, heavy_distance / heavy_active_ticks, flask_walk_speed / 60

props.description: Makes a phase 2: entered, roaring, once a hit leaves at most this much of its full health.

props.name: phase2_speed_scale
props.description: Phase 2: startups, the combo's gap and the rest times this, rounded; walking, turning and tracking divided by it.

props.name: phase2_combo_hits
props.description: Phase 2: how many cuts the combo has.

props.name: roar_ticks
props.description: How long the roar on entering phase 2 lasts, invulnerable.

props.name: roar_blast_tick
props.description: The tick of the roar with the blast all around; at most roar_ticks.

props.name: roar_damage
props.description: Health the blast takes off the character.

props.name: roar_impact
props.description: What the blast adds up against the character's poise.

props.name: roar_reach
props.description: The radius of the blast.

props.name: spin_damage
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: health each hit takes off the character.

props.name: spin_impact
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: what each hit adds up against the character's poise.

props.name: spin_startup_ticks
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: the warning before the swing, turning to the character at track_speed.

props.name: spin_active_ticks
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: the swing (for a combo, each cut's).

props.name: spin_recovery_ticks
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: after the swing (for a combo, the last cut's).

props.name: spin_reach
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: radius of the swept sector.

props.name: spin_arc
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: angle swept, right to left, centered on the facing.

props.name: spin_min_range
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: chosen only with the character at least this far, horizontally.

props.name: spin_max_range
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: chosen only with the character at most this far; at least min_range.

props.name: spin_weight
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: how likely it is chosen, against the weights of the other moves in range; 0: never.

props.name: spin_track_speed
props.description: Spin, a full turn on the spot, only in phase 2: how fast the enemy turns to the character during the startup.

props.name: bonfire_range
props.description: Makes the node a bonfire: the character sits down at it within this horizontal distance.

props.name: souls
props.description: What the character gets each time it kills the node.

props.name: boss_bar
props.description: 1: the HUD shows the enemy's health at the bottom while the character is within its aggro range.

requires: hurt_radius and hurt_height: both or neither
poise, stagger_ticks, poise_reset_ticks, revive_ticks, souls: need hp
swing_impact, swing_startup_ticks, swing_active_ticks, swing_recovery_ticks, swing_reach, swing_arc, swing_low, swing_high: need swing_damage
every enemy_*, sweep_*, cleave_*, lunge_*, combo_*, approach_*, phase2_*, roar_* and spin_* prop but enemy_speed, and boss_bar: need enemy_speed
phase2_speed_scale, phase2_combo_hits, roar_ticks, roar_blast_tick, roar_damage, roar_impact, roar_reach: need phase2_at
constraints: lock-on targets, hurtboxes and swingers are root nodes, and not the camera
a hurtbox with hp: its child named hp_bar, if any, needs a mesh
a swinger or an enemy: its child named arm, if any, needs a mesh
an enemy (a node with enemy_speed): <move>_min_range <= <move>_max_range for sweep, cleave, lunge, combo and spin
an enemy needs hurt_radius, hurt_height, hp and lock_height, and is not a swinger
an enemy: enemy_speed / 60, lunge_distance / lunge_active_ticks and, with phase2_at, enemy_speed / 60 / phase2_speed_scale are less than hurt_radius
an enemy has no collider in its subtree
a bonfire (a node with bonfire_range) is a root node, and not the camera, and not also a lock target, hurtbox, swinger or enemy
the bloodstain marker (the root node named bloodstain) has a mesh, and no props or children
an enemy with boss_bar 1: its display_name has only the characters 32 to 126
